provider: CUHK Bachelor of Arts in Early Childhood Education Programme Study Scheme and Course List
academicYear: Applicable to students admitted in 2017-18 and thereafter (Higher Diploma holders)
note: The CUHK admission page links the Bachelor of Arts in Early Childhood Education Programme. Its official Study Scheme applies to Higher Diploma holders admitted in 2017-18 and thereafter and requires 55 Major units: 47 Required units and 8 Elective units. Required courses comprise 8 units of Educational Studies, 29 units of Subject Knowledge, 7 units of Research Experience and a 3-unit Internship. Students additionally complete 8 units from the 15-course Elective pool. The Programme's official Course List publishes all 31 codes, English titles and per-course units used below and states that the list is subject to change without prior notice. The 70-71 minimum graduation total also contains 15-16 units of University Core Requirements that are not a closed Programme course list and are not imported here. The Major GPA note for CHED, EDUC and SPED courses at level 2000 or above and the hash-marked BECE3130 and MUSC2545 is retained as a planning note rather than simplified into an automatic graduation decision.
